_meta.pipeline: IndicTransToolkit 1.1.1 preprocess -> reference slow tokenizer -> onnxruntime 1.24.2 CPU EP, default SessionOptions, greedy decode (start </s>=2, argmax at last position, stop on </s> or 256 generated tokens) -> batch_decode(skip_special_tokens, clean_up_tokenization_spaces) -> IndicProcessor.postprocess_batch
_meta.note: onnxruntime is pinned to the version both apps ship; other versions can argmax differently on near-ties (1.28.0 differs on cases 14, 17 and 21). generated_ids exclude the trailing </s>. Expected values come from the reference pipeline; never edit one to make an engine pass.

cases.input: Please bless my family with health and happiness, and keep us in your protection.
cases.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਹਤ ਅਤੇ ਖੁਸ਼ੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਅਸ਼ੀਰਵਾਦ ਦਿਓ, ਅਤੇ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖੋ।

cases.input: Guide my children on the right path and give them the strength to live truthfully.
cases.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਹੀ ਰਸਤੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਲੈ ਜਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੱਚਮੁੱਚ ਜੀਉਣ ਦੀ ਤਾਕਤ ਦਿਓ।

cases.input: We pray for the recovery of my mother, who is unwell. Grant her healing and peace.
cases.gurmukhi: ਅਸੀਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਿਹਤਯਾਬੀ ਲਈ ਪ੍ਰਾਰਥਨਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਾਂ, ਜੋ ਬਿਮਾਰ ਹੈ। ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਹਤ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਾਂਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਦਾਨ ਕਰੋ।

cases.input: Bless this new home we are moving into, and may it always be filled with your name.
cases.gurmukhi: ਇਸ ਨਵੇਂ ਘਰ ਨੂੰ ਅਸ਼ੀਰਵਾਦ ਦਿਓ ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਸੀਂ ਜਾ ਰਹੇ ਹਾਂ, ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਲ ਭਰਿਆ ਰਹੇ।

cases.input: Give me the courage to face the difficulties at work and to act with honesty.
cases.gurmukhi: ਮੈਨੂੰ ਕੰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੁਸ਼ਕਿਲਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਇਮਾਨਦਾਰੀ ਨਾਲ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਹਿੰਮਤ ਦਿਓ।

cases.input: O true King, we humbly place this prayer at your feet; forgive our shortcomings.
cases.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਸੱਚੇ ਰਾਜਾ, ਅਸੀਂ ਨਿਮਰਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਇਹ ਪ੍ਰਾਰਥਨਾ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਹਾਂ; ਸਾਡੀਆਂ ਕਮੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਫ਼ ਕਰ ਦਿਓ।

cases.input: "Do good deeds," my mother said; we remember her words.
cases.gurmukhi: "ਚੰਗੇ ਕੰਮ ਕਰੋ", ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਂ ਨੇ ਕਿਹਾ; ਸਾਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਯਾਦ ਹਨ।

cases.input: She said ‘chardi kala’ and smiled — “always”.
cases.gurmukhi: ਉਸ ਨੇ'ਚਾਰਦੀ ਕਾਲਾ'ਕਿਹਾ ਅਤੇ ਮੁਸਕਰਾਈ-"ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ"।

cases.input: Bless the sangat of 25 families who gathered (despite the rain) at the Gurdwara.
cases.gurmukhi: (ਮੀਂਹ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ) ਗੁਰੂਦ੍ਵਾਰੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਹੋਏ 25 ਪਰਿਵਾਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੰਗਤ ਨੂੰ ਅਸ਼ੀਰਵਾਦ ਦਿਓ।

cases.input: Waheguru ji, please bless us -- we don't know what tomorrow holds.
cases.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੇਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ, ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਅਸ਼ੀਰਵਾਦ ਦਿਓ-- ਸਾਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਤਾ ਕਿ ਕੱਲ੍ਹ ਕੀ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ।

cases.input: My daughter's exams begin on Monday; give her courage, focus and calm.
cases.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਧੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਸੋਮਵਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ; ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹਿੰਮਤ, ਧਿਆਨ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਾਂਤੀ ਦਿਓ।

cases.input: We can't repay your kindness... forgive us.
cases.gurmukhi: ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਦਿਆਲਤਾ ਦਾ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ... ਸਾਨੂੰ ਮਾਫ਼ ਕਰ ਦਿਓ।

cases.input: It's the family's hope that we'll serve more; they've promised to help.
cases.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਦੀ ਉਮੀਦ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਅਸੀਂ ਹੋਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਾਂਗੇ; ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਵਾਅਦਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ।

cases.input: He said, "Don't worry about the 90% result; it's in God's hands!"
cases.gurmukhi: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਿਹਾ, "90 ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਨਤੀਜੇ ਦੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ, ਇਹ ਰੱਬ ਦੇ ਹੱਥ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੈ!"

cases.input: Grant success in the new venture starting on 2026-08-15, and keep pride away.
cases.gurmukhi: 2026-08-15 ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਨਵੇਂ ਉੱਦਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਫਲਤਾ ਦਿਓ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਣ ਨੂੰ ਦੂਰ ਰੱਖੋ।

cases.input: Mr. Singh and Dr. Kaur will visit St. Mary's Hospital on Jan. 5 at 9:30 a.m.
cases.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਸਿੰਘ ਅਤੇ ਡਾ. ਕੌਰ 5 ਜਨਵਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਵੇਰੇ 9.30 ਵਜੇ ਸੇਂਟ ਮੈਰੀਜ਼ ਹਸਪਤਾਲ ਜਾਣਗੇ।

cases.input: Please protect Amrit, Gurpreet & Simran — their travels span 1,200 miles.
cases.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ, ਗੁਰਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਮਰਾਨ ਦੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰੋ-ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਯਾਤਰਾ 1,200 ਮੀਲ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।

cases.input: O Waheguru, bless grandmother — she is 87 — with strength;   guide us all.
cases.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਵਾਹੇਗੁਰੂ, ਦਾਦੀ ਨੂੰ ਅਸ਼ੀਰਵਾਦ ਦਿਓ-ਉਹ 87 ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਹੈ-ਤਾਕਤ ਨਾਲ; ਸਾਡੇ ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਮਾਰਗਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਕਰੋ।

cases.input: We walked 12 cm deep in snow; the offering was 10 % of everything.
cases.gurmukhi: ਅਸੀਂ ਬਰਫ ਵਿੱਚ 12 ਸੈਂਟੀਮੀਟਰ ਡੂੰਘੇ ਤੁਰ ਪਏ; ਪੇਸ਼ਕਸ਼ ਹਰ ਚੀਜ਼ ਦਾ 10 ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਸੀ।

cases.input: The village of Gmina Ardaas is peaceful.
cases.gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸ ਪਿੰਡ ਸ਼ਾਂਤੀਪੂਰਨ ਹੈ।

cases.input: O merciful and eternal Waheguru, we stand before you with folded hands and humble hearts, asking that you watch over every member of this family, near and far, protect the elders in their old age, guide the young ones through their studies and their struggles, keep sickness and sorrow away from this home, and give us all the wisdom to remember your name in happiness as well as in hardship.
cases.gurmukhi: ਹੇ ਦਿਆਲੂ ਅਤੇ ਸਦੀਵੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ, ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਹੱਥ ਜੋਡ਼ ਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਮਰ ਦਿਲ ਨਾਲ ਖਡ਼੍ਹੇ ਹਾਂ, ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਾਂ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇਸ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਦੇ ਹਰ ਮੈਂਬਰ, ਨੇਡ਼ੇ ਅਤੇ ਦੂਰ, ਦੀ ਰਾਖੀ ਕਰੋ, ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗਾਂ ਦੀ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਬੁਢਾਪੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰੋ, ਨੌਜਵਾਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਡ਼੍ਹਾਈ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਘਰਸ਼ਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੇਧ ਦਿਓ, ਬਿਮਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਇਸ ਘਰ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਰ ਰੱਖੋ, ਅਤੇ ਸਾਨੂੰ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ-ਨਾਲ ਮੁਸ਼ਕਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਨਾਮ ਯਾਦ ਰੱਖਣ ਦੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਦਿਓ।
